:::{#thm-projection-orthogonal}
#### Projection matrices produce orthogonal decompositions

If $\matr{P}$ is a $p \times p$ orthogonal projection matrix (@def-projection-matrix)
and $\vecf{v}$ is any vector of length $p$, then
the two components of the decomposition

$$\vecf{v} = \underbrace{\matr{P}\vecf{v}}_{\text{projected}} + \underbrace{(\matr{I}_p - \matr{P})\vecf{v}}_{\text{residual}}$$

are orthogonal:

$$\matr{P}\vecf{v} \;\perp\; (\matr{I}_p - \matr{P})\vecf{v}$$

:::
